Potions are the main source of income in Potion Maker. The type of potion that is created is dependent on the starting material placed into the cauldron. After the type has been selected, it cannot be changed. The potions and materials in the game fall under three basic categories, with the exception of tutorial potion.

Enhancement[]

Potions can be enhanced, which multiplies the selling price of the potion. There is a chance the enhancement will fail, the success rate for the next enhancement is displayed while making the potion. Each successive enhancement will have a larger multiplier, but also a smaller success rate, with the except of stamina potions, which have a constant multiplier rate and success rate regardless of the level.

Tutorial Potion[]

Tutorial potion is only available at the start of the game, it is created by adding purple tutorial materials to the cauldron. After that, the material will never appear again, making tutorial potions impossible to produce. It has a base price of 10 coins, multiplicity rate of 3 (for two enhancements), and success rates of 95%, then 30%.

Trivia[]

  • Potions brewing in the cauldron will bubble when a material of the same color is added. Other colors will not produce the bubbling effect.
  • Upon closer inspection of tutorial potion's image, it is actually a recolored version of Small HP Potion.
  • Tia has stated that the way Pio makes potions is unlike any way that has been taught in the academy.
